Hi all — I'm Stephanie, currently an independent researcher (two degrees from Chicago back in the day :). I've been formalizing the core of my research work in Lean so the results would be checkable.

Most of my research is number-theory and quadratic-form flavored (https://github.com/stalex444/pdt-lean): 119 theorems, 11 modules, no sorry, no native_decide, standard axioms only, with a one-cell Colab that rebuilds against pinned Mathlib and self-certifies): the trace-form signatures (3,1) and (2,1) of ℚ[x]/(x⁴−x−1) and ℚ[x]/(x³−x−1) via Sylvester's law, and the norm / discriminant / irreducibility of those polynomials through the genuine Algebra.norm / discr / traceForm API rather than hand-substituted values.

It's part of a physics-motivated project, so there's also some quantum-foundations content — single-system QM kinematics (the Born-rule form, observables, unitarity) from one explicit hypothesis H ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℂ, and the CHSH / Tsirelson bounds via Mathlib's tsirelson_inequality. But I'm just focusing on the math atm.

I'm here mostly to learn and get better at this. I'd welcome any eyes on it (plenty could surely be more idiomatic), and I'm currently trying to extend the arithmetic/structural layer, so pointers to relevant Mathlib API are very welcome. Glad to be here — it looks like a generous place to learn. Plus, I guess I need friends. :)
